crossRefs.note: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of…
Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
“One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
“ ‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies…
then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that…

translations.web: “ ‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
translations.bsb: And if a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.
translations.kjv: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
translations.asv: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
